ideas.title: The Impact of Funding Freezes on Local Communities
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Trump administration's funding freezes on local communities, including the Gateway tunnel project and child care programs.
ideas.angle: The human impact of funding freezes
questions: How have funding freezes affected local communities?
What are the long-term consequences of these freezes?
ideas.insight: The Trump administration's funding freezes have the potential to have a significant impact on local communities, and it is essential to investigate the human impact of these actions.
